assessments.summary: Measles cases in the US are peaking with a 225% increase in weekly reported cases over the past 8 months, and news coverage is rising sharply.
Dengue cases in the US are peaking with a 1003% increase in weekly reported cases over the past 8 months, and news coverage is rising sharply.
Global flu test positivity is rising, with US hospital admissions up 55% over the past month, and WHO reported a case of influenza A(H5N1) in Washington State.
Whooping cough cases in the US are rising with a 52% increase in weekly reported cases over the past 8 months, and news coverage is rising sharply.
Mpox cases in the US are rising with a 100% increase in weekly reported cases over the past 8 months, and news coverage is rising sharply.
Polio cases in Syria are rising with a cluster of four acute flaccid paralysis cases reported in Deir Ez Zor Governorate.
US COVID-19 hospital admissions are rising with a 13% increase over the past month, and Wikipedia readership is at a very low level.
Malaria cases in the US are rising with a 13% increase in weekly reported cases over the past 8 months, and news coverage is rising slightly.
RSV activity is at baseline levels with a score of 51/100, showing a slight increase in test positivity and hospitalizations compared to the previous month.
West Nile virus activity is rising with a score of 51/100, as US cases have surged 1562% compared to the previous 8 months.
Chikungunya activity is at baseline with a score of 49/100, but Switzerland reported its first locally acquired cases this year.
Human metapneumovirus activity is rising with a score of 49/100, driven by increased news coverage.
Cholera activity is at baseline with a score of 46/100, with rising news coverage but low Wikipedia readership.
Ebola activity is at baseline with a score of 45/100, with ongoing transmission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring countries.
Legionnaires' disease activity is at baseline with a score of 43/100, showing a slight decline in US cases compared to the previous year.
